mnemo.description: mnemo: self-hosted shared agent memory (Qdrant on port 1337, OpenAI embeddings)

gpt-image-2.description: gpt-image-2: generate and edit raster images via OpenAI's Image API (paid, writes files). Reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the inherited environment; no env block, because the value must never appear in configuration. `timeout` is the per-server tool wall clock in ms (Claude Code v2.1.203+), set above the server's own 540s deadline and scoped to this server so it cannot shorten any other server's ceiling.

optical-compression.description: optical-compression: render large text payloads as token-cheap images (~2.9x fewer tokens at the default density) and retrieve the exact original by digest. Fully offline: no network or credentials; the env block only identifies the host. LOSSY for exact values by design - the image is gist, optical_retrieve is the source of truth. Needs Pillow.
